overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines that differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether 'object' is an object-name string vs. a form variable reference). That's one semantic overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator, not two independent overloads.

params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: row
params.description: Row number of the break row's first occurrence (as returned by LISTBOX GET CELL POSITION).

params.name: column
params.description: Column number of the break row's first occurrence (as returned by LISTBOX GET CELL POSITION).

params.name: action
params.description: Selection action to apply when a row/break selection already exists.

sentinelValues.meaning: lk replace selection (default): the new selection replaces the existing selection, like a user click (no On Clicked event fired).
lk add to selection: adds to the existing selection.
lk remove from selection: removes from the existing selection.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Selects a break row (identified by its first-occurrence row/column) in a hierarchical-mode list box.

constraints: The list box must be displayed in hierarchical mode.
Break rows don't correspond to real array rows; row/column must be the first-occurrence coordinates reported by LISTBOX GET CELL POSITION.
